Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Controls: arrows move, Z jump, X attack, C dash, A bind; Up interact. Observed: mossy platforms, forest pillars, black mushrooms, vines, gaps, standable ornate cage, large ornate spherical structure with swirl pattern and keyhole, scattered green particles. Meters last seen full health/soul, shell shards 20+0. Boss defeated by repeated X. Glowing green snail removed by pointer click ~0.65,0.45, which also moved red-cloak character forward/lower-right; snail absent afterward. Failed: Right+jump+dash fell left edge before snail; right-edge falls and wall-cling blocked progress; left wall blocked. Sphere probing with no confirmed entry/transition: repeated Up, C into structure, Z jumps, pointer ~0.6,0.35, A, Right+Z (jumped past), Left+Z (prone/crawling on moss facing sphere; pattern unchanged, area cleared). Later Z left character airborne above/right of sphere. Agent reported standing atop sphere facing right and pressed Up (0.4s); next view was character standing on moss right of sphere, facing it, sword drawn. Then Left+Z, Left+C, A, Right+Z, and Up (each 0.4s) left character there with mushrooms/particles nearby, meters unchanged, snail gone, no entry. A subsequent Left+Z (0.4s) was followed by a view of the character standing atop the sphere facing left; agent pressed Up (0.4s). Next confirmed view: character standing on moss left of sphere, facing it, sword drawn, mushrooms/particles nearby, meters full, shards 20+0, snail gone, area cleared—so that Up did not enter and character was off the sphere on the left. Latest action Right+Z (0.4s) completed; no post-action visual, effect unknown. Active goals: determine snail effect; probe sphere/right exit; test whether standing on sphere plus interact enters. Guesses only: snail collectible/warp; sphere portal/exit; atop position required; prior Ups caused slide-off; Left+Z can climb onto sphere. Uncertainty: whether atop-sphere views were stable or jump frames; result of latest Right+Z; whether prior inputs were interact-only vs failed entry; exact snail effect; hidden areas. Evidence limited to sequence, action-completion results, and screenshot/agent observations; no private game state inferred.
